task: Complete Phase 1 scoring foundations after PR #1: versioned rubric anchors, initial category checklists, verified crawler policy, frozen scoring examples, and executable validation before building the audit app.
nonGoals: Build or deploy the product app
Start the Phase 2 live feasibility prototype
Use paid services or model calls
Change rubric weights without explicit approval
Re-enable the GitHub approval requirement the user removed

outcomes.description: All 13 criteria and agreed subchecks have versioned weights, evidence requirements, full/partial/zero anchors, applicability and incomplete-result rules totaling Structure 40 and Content 60.

Running shoes, casual daypacks, and basic T-shirts have explicit essential/supporting attributes and category questions mapped to the approved content criteria without invented product facts or duplicate scoring homes.
Versioned bot registry distinguishes search, AI retrieval, user-triggered, and training agents using official evidence and explicit unknowns; training policy never loses S5 points.

At least five frozen synthetic reference scenarios cover full credit, partial/missing content, not-measured, conditional non-applicability, and delivery/policy distinctions with exact expected arithmetic and no claim of human/live calibration.
The Phase 1 branch opens a PR with current evidence, independent Terra technical review, and hosted CI before any merge.

process.description: Acceptance plan is committed first; Terra agents own separate category, crawler and rubric-validation work, with official sources cited and no paid resources.
process.evidence: Git history, source references, and agent review report

process.description: Written process reflects user-removed GitHub approval requirement while preserving mandatory CI and independent technical review; no repository settings are changed.
process.evidence: AGENTS.md, evals/PROCESS.md, and vault process note

styleEfficiency.description: Keep data versioned and readable, tests offline, unknown measurements explicit, and atomic notes linked to canonical technical files.
styleEfficiency.evidence: Independent Terra review and real run/trace records

exitTest.reason: This change establishes the phase handoff and aligns agent review/process policy with the user's GitHub setting change; verify continuation from a clean export.
